responsibility: Implements IBM S/390 and zSeries common target state, combining processor capability metadata with option defaults and validation. The file exports the processor_flags_table that maps z-architecture CPU levels to feature masks used elsewhere in the port, defines optimization defaults such as sched-pressure and size-oriented MVCLE use, initializes asynchronous unwind tables and section anchors, validates stack-guard and stack-size options as powers of two, and reports split-stack support, making it the shared option and feature-description layer for the S/390 backend.
